13 module l2_ram_multi_bank #(
14    parameter NB_BANKS                   = 4,
15    // Don't forget to adjust the SRAM macros and the FPGA settings if you change the banksizes
16    parameter int unsigned BANK_SIZE_INTL_SRAM = 32768 //Number of 32-bit words
17 ) (
18    input logic             clk_i,
19    input logic             rst_ni,
20    input logic             init_ni,
21    input logic             test_mode_i,
22    XBAR_TCDM_BUS.Slave     mem_slave[NB_BANKS],
23    XBAR_TCDM_BUS.Slave     mem_pri_slave[2]
24 );
25     // Don't forget to adjust the SRAM macros and the FPGA settings if you change the banksizes
26     localparam int unsigned BANK_SIZE_PRI0       = 8192; //Number of 32-bit words
27     localparam int unsigned BANK_SIZE_PRI1       = 8192; //Number of 32-bit words
28 
29     //Derived parameters
30     localparam int unsigned INTL_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(BANK_SIZE_INTL_SRAM);
31     localparam int unsigned PRI0_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(BANK_SIZE_PRI0);
32     localparam int unsigned PRI1_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(BANK_SIZE_PRI1);
33 
34     //Used in testbenches
35 
36 
37 
38     //INTERLEAVED Memory
39     logic [31:0]           interleaved_addresses[NB_BANKS];
40     for(genvar i=0; i<NB_BANKS; i++) begin : CUTS
41         //Perform TCDM handshaking for constant 1 cycle latency
42         assign mem_slave[i].gnt = mem_slave[i].req;
43         assign mem_slave[i].r_opc = 1'b0;
44         always_ff @(posedge clk_i, negedge rst_ni) begin
45             if (!rst_ni) begin
46                 mem_slave[i].r_valid <= 1'b0;
47             end else begin
48                 mem_slave[i].r_valid <= mem_slave[i].req;
49             end
50         end
51        //Remove Address offset
52        assign interleaved_addresses[i] = mem_slave[i].add - `SOC_MEM_MAP_TCDM_START_ADDR;
53 
54       `ifndef PULP_FPGA_EMUL
55           tc_sram #(
56             .NumWords  ( BANK_SIZE_INTL_SRAM ),
57             .DataWidth ( 32                  ),
58             .NumPorts  ( 1                   )
59           ) bank_i (
60             .clk_i,
61             .rst_ni,
62             .req_i   (  mem_slave[i].req                                  ),
63             .we_i    ( ~mem_slave[i].wen                                  ),
64             .addr_i  (  interleaved_addresses[i][INTL_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH+2+$clog2(NB_BANKS)-1:2+$clog2(NB_BANKS)] ), // Remove LSBs for byte addressing (2 bits)
65                                                                                                                  // and bank selection (log2(NB_BANKS) bits)
66             .wdata_i (  mem_slave[i].wdata                                ),
67             .be_i    (  mem_slave[i].be                                   ),
68             .rdata_o (  mem_slave[i].r_rdata                              )
69           );
70 
71       `else // !`ifndef PULP_FPGA_EMUL
72           fpga_interleaved_ram #(.ADDR_WIDTH(INTL_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH)) bank_i
73               (
74                .clk_i,
75                .rst_ni,
76                .csn_i   (~mem_slave[i].req                                 ),
77                .wen_i   (mem_slave[i].wen                                  ),
78                .be_i    (mem_slave[i].be                                   ),
79                .addr_i  (interleaved_addresses[i][INTL_MEM_ADDR_WIDTH-1+2+$clog2(NB_BANKS):2+$clog2(NB_BANKS)] ), // Remove LSBs for byte addressing (2 bits)
80                                                                                                                   // and bank selection (log2(NB_BANKS) bits)
81                .wdata_i (mem_slave[i].wdata                                ),
82                .rdata_o (mem_slave[i].r_rdata                              )
83                );
84       `endif

16     )
17     (
18      input logic             clk_i,
19      input logic             rst_ni,
20      input logic             init_ni,
21      XBAR_TCDM_BUS.Slave     mem_slave,
22      input logic             test_mode_i
23     );
24 
25     assign mem_slave.r_opc = 1'b0;
26 
27     //Perform TCDM handshaking for constant 1 cycle latency
28     assign mem_slave.gnt     = mem_slave.req;
29     always_ff @(posedge clk_i, negedge rst_ni) begin
30         if (!rst_ni) begin
31             mem_slave.r_valid <= 1'b0;
32         end else begin
33             mem_slave.r_valid <= mem_slave.req;
34         end
35     end
36 
37     //Remove address offset
38     logic [31:0] address;
39     assign address = mem_slave.add - `SOC_MEM_MAP_BOOT_ROM_START_ADDR;

41     `ifndef PULP_FPGA_EMUL
42 
43         generic_rom #(
44             .ADDR_WIDTH(ROM_ADDR_WIDTH-2), //The ROM uses 32-bit word addressing while the bus addresses bytes
45             .DATA_WIDTH(32)
46          ) rom_mem_i (
47             .CLK            (  clk_i                ),
48             .CEN            (  ~mem_slave.req        ),
49             .A              (  address[ROM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:2]  ), //Cutoff insignificant address bits. The
50                                                                      //interconnect makes sure we only receive addresses in the bootrom address space
51             .Q              (  mem_slave.r_rdata      )
52         );
53 
54         // assign mem_slave.add[31:ROM_ADDR_WIDTH] = '0;
55 
56     `else // !`ifndef PULP_FPGA_EMUL
57 
58     fpga_bootrom #(
59                    .ADDR_WIDTH(ROM_ADDR_WIDTH-2), //The ROM uses 32-bit word addressing while the bus addresses bytes
60                    .DATA_WIDTH(32)
61                    ) rom_mem_i (
62                             .CLK(clk_i),
63                             .CEN(~mem_slave.req),
64                             .A(address[ROM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:2]), //Cutoff insignificant address bits. The interconnect
65                                                                    //makes sure we only receive addresses in the bootrom address space
66                             .Q(mem_slave.r_rdata)
67                             );
68 
69     `endif

12 module scm_2048x32
13 (
14     input  logic        CLK,
15     input  logic        RSTN,
16 
17     input  logic        CEN,
18     input  logic        CEN_scm0,
19     input  logic        CEN_scm1,
20 
21     input  logic        WEN,
22     input  logic        WEN_scm0,
23     input  logic        WEN_scm1,
24 
25     input  logic  [3:0] BE,
26     input  logic  [3:0] BE_scm0,
27 
28     input  logic [10:0] A,
29     input  logic [10:0] A_scm0,
30     input  logic [10:0] A_scm1,
31 
32     input  logic [31:0] D,
33     input  logic [31:0] D_scm0,
34 
35     output logic [31:0] Q,
36     output logic [31:0] Q_scm0,
37     output logic [31:0] Q_scm1
38 );
39     localparam NB_BANKS   = 16;
40     localparam ADDR_WIDTH =  7;
41 
42     logic [NB_BANKS-1:0] CEN_int, CEN_scm0_int, CEN_scm1_int;
43     logic [NB_BANKS-1:0] read_enA, read_enB, read_enC;
44     logic [NB_BANKS-1:0] write_enA, write_enB;
45     logic [NB_BANKS-1:0][31:0] Q_int, Q_int_scm0, Q_int_scm1;
46     logic [3:0]  muxsel_A, muxsel_A_scm0, muxsel_A_scm1;
47 
48      always_ff @(posedge CLK or negedge RSTN)
49      begin
50         if(~RSTN)
51         begin
52             muxsel_A      <= '0;
53             muxsel_A_scm0 <= '0;
54             muxsel_A_scm1 <= '0;
55         end
56         else
57         begin
58             if (CEN == 1'b0)
59                  muxsel_A      <= A[10:7];
60             if (CEN_scm0 == 1'b0)
61                  muxsel_A_scm0 <= A_scm0[10:7];
62             if (CEN_scm1 == 1'b0)
63                  muxsel_A_scm1 <= A_scm1[10:7];
64         end
65      end
66 
67     assign Q      = Q_int[muxsel_A];
68     assign Q_scm0 = Q_int_scm0[muxsel_A_scm0];
69     assign Q_scm1 = Q_int_scm1[muxsel_A_scm1];
70 
71 
72     //16 SCM Banks, each 128x32 bit
73      genvar                      i;
74      generate
75      for(i=0; i<NB_BANKS; i++)
76      begin : SCM_CUT
77 
78         assign CEN_int[i]       = CEN      | A[10:7]      != i;
79         assign CEN_scm0_int[i]  = CEN_scm0 | A_scm0[10:7] != i;
80         assign CEN_scm1_int[i]  = CEN_scm1 | A_scm1[10:7] != i;
81 
82         assign read_enA[i]      = ~CEN_int[i]      & WEN;
83         assign read_enB[i]      = ~CEN_scm0_int[i] & WEN_scm0;
84         assign read_enC[i]      = ~CEN_scm1_int[i] & WEN_scm1;
85 
86         assign write_enA[i]     = ~CEN_int[i]      & ~WEN;
